title: Revert glassmorphism theme to previous version

requirements.text: Revert all glassmorphism theme changes applied in the most recent update (version 14) across all frontend files, restoring the UI to its prior state before the glassmorphism theme was applied site-wide.
acceptanceCriteria: All frontend files that were modified to apply the glassmorphism theme are restored to their pre-glassmorphism state.
The site visually matches the version prior to the glassmorphism update.
No glassmorphism-specific utility classes or styles introduced in the latest update remain active across components.
All pages (Home, Annual Program, Our Legacy) render correctly without glassmorphism overrides from the reverted changes.

constraints: Do not change backend logic or data models.
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Introducing any new design changes or features.
Removing the glassmorphism CSS tokens from the design system if they were pre-existing before version 14.
